# Perplexity API Changelog Summary

## May 2026
- **Finance Search Tool**: Structured financial data including quotes, financials, earnings, analyst estimates, and ETFs now available in Agent API

## April 2026
- **New Models**: Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5, Grok 4.20 Reasoning added to Agent API
- **API Key Security**: One-time reveal model implemented; keys only visible at creation
- **n8n Integration**: Native Perplexity node with full API coverage
- **OpenClaw Integration**: Terminal AI agent support for Perplexity Search
- **AWS Marketplace**: API credits purchasable through AWS account
- **GET /v1/models Endpoint**: Lists available Agent API models in OpenAI format

## March 2026
- **New Models**: GPT-5.4, NVIDIA Nemotron, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro added
- **Model Deprecations**: Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro and Gemini 3 Pro Preview removed
- **Agent API Endpoint**: `/v1/agent` now canonical (previous `/v1/responses` alias maintained)

## February 2026
- **Agent API**: General availability announced with production guidance
- **Embeddings API**: Launched with semantic search and retrieval guides

## December 2025
- **Model Removal**: `sonar-reasoning` deprecated
- **Media Classifier**: Auto-detects visual content needs for responses
- **Search API**: `max_tokens` parameter, `last_updated_filter`, Vercel AI SDK support

## November 2025
- **Pro Search**: Multi-step reasoning with automated tool usage now GA
- **MCP Server**: One-click installation for Cursor, VS Code, Claude Desktop

## October 2025
- **Official SDKs**: Python and TypeScript SDKs released
- **Search Playground**: Interactive testing without API key requirement
- **Search Capabilities**: `language_preference`, `search_domain_filter`, date/time filters

## September 2025
- **File Attachments**: PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT, RTF document analysis
- **Search-only API**: Standalone endpoint for raw search results
- **API Key Rotation**: Comprehensive key management system

## August 2025
- **Model Deprecation**: R1-1776 removed; migration to Sonar Pro Reasoning recommended

## July 2025
- **Cost Tracking**: Detailed cost breakdown in API responses
- **SEC Filings Filter**: Domain filtering for regulatory documents

## June 2025
- **Date Filtering**: `latest_updated` field for content freshness
- **Academic Filter**: `search_mode: "academic"` for peer-reviewed sources

## May 2025
- **Reasoning Effort**: Control computational depth ("low/medium/high") for Sonar Deep Research
- **Async API**: Asynchronous endpoints for extended research tasks
- **Search Results Field**: New `search_results` field with title/URL/date; `citations` deprecated

## April 2025
- **API Portal**: Organization management at console.perplexity.ai
- **Location Filtering**: Geography-based search result narrowing
- **Image Uploads**: Multimodal image support for all users
- **Date Range Filtering**: Temporal search constraints
- **Citation Token Pricing**: Eliminated; citation tokens no longer charged
- **Feature Access**: All capabilities available to all users regardless of tier
- **Structured Outputs**: Removed Tier 3 requirement; available to everyone

## March 2025
- **Search Modes**: High/Medium/Low options across Sonar models
- **Simplified Billing**: Transparent token pricing; no citation token charges (except Deep Research)

## January 2025
- **Model Deprecations**: Llama 3.1 Sonar models discontinued
- **New APIs**: Sonar and Sonar Pro launched as primary offerings

## November 2024
- **Citations Release**: Public availability; default rate limits increased to 50 req/min

## July 2024
- **Llama 3.1 Sonar Models**: New online and chat variants
- **Model Deprecations**: Multiple older models removed (8/12/2024)

## April 2024
- **Model Deprecations**: CodeLlama, Mistral, Mixtral variants removed (5/14/2024)

## Last Fetched
2026-05-18 — NEW: Finance Search Tool in Agent API (May 2026); Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5, Grok 4.20 Reasoning models added (April 2026); API Key one-time-reveal security model (April 2026).
